theorem guardOkM_cost : γ.guardOkM.cost = γ.guardC := by
  unfold guardOkM guardC
  rw [anyM_cost 1 _ (fun ij => accessC γ.nodes ij.1 + (accessC γ.nodes ij.2 +
    (nodeC (γ.nodes.getD ij.1 (.app 0 [])) + nodeC (γ.nodes.getD ij.2 (.app 0 [])) +
      natC γ.x + natC γ.y))) (fun ij => by simp)]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]

γ : Instance
⊢ (anyM 1
        (fun ij => do
          let a ← getDM' γ.nodes ij.1 (Node.app 0 [])
          let b ← getDM' γ.nodes ij.2 (Node.app 0 [])
          tick (nodeC a + nodeC b + natC γ.x + natC γ.y)
          Pure.pure (decide (a = Node.src γ.x) && decide (b = Node.src γ.y)))
        γ.tests).cost =
    (List.map
        (fun ij =>
          1 + accessC γ.nodes ij.1 + accessC γ.nodes ij.2 + nodeC (γ.nodes.getD ij.1 (Node.app 0 [])) +
                nodeC (γ.nodes.getD ij.2 (Node.app 0 [])) +
              natC γ.x +
            natC γ.y)
        γ.tests).sum

γ : Instance
⊢ (List.map
        (fun a =>
          1 +
            (accessC γ.nodes a.1 +
              (accessC γ.nodes a.2 +
                (nodeC (γ.nodes.getD a.1 (Node.app 0 [])) + nodeC (γ.nodes.getD a.2 (Node.app 0 [])) + natC γ.x +
                  natC γ.y))))
        γ.tests).sum =
    (List.map
        (fun ij =>
          1 + accessC γ.nodes ij.1 + accessC γ.nodes ij.2 + nodeC (γ.nodes.getD ij.1 (Node.app 0 [])) +
                nodeC (γ.nodes.getD ij.2 (Node.app 0 [])) +
              natC γ.x +
            natC γ.y)
        γ.tests).sum
